jobs.note: [est 45 min] Atlas docs/035 §10 constructor census, arm CtorRules=1 (today's default: the census rules before docs/035 §10; its failure stops the queue, levels 2..5 build on it), OwnReader=2 (our reader plus EA's full read of the same bytes, compared record by record; test only: EA's constructors run twice, timing not comparable): inspect, then two loader A page-ins (cold, warm) on each of three pageable lots of Sunset Valley (10th percentile, median and largest object count), verify after each, clean. Pass: every step logs RESULT PASS, loadA path A six times, the hook went in with ctor rules 1 (reader-2), the native start line reads back CtorRules=1 and sr 2, six reader summaries with our graph at ctor rules 1, compare PASS six times, no fallback, no script error.
